cases.question: Which SQL keywords are banned by AST policy SQL-AST-RO and what numerical tolerance is enforced by NUM-PARITY-100?
cases.reference_summary: Policy SQL-AST-RO blocks INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, ALTER, ATTACH, and PRAGMA, while NUM-PARITY-100 verifies every number within a 0.01 tolerance.

cases.question: How does control HITL-DRIFT-SHA compute the composite evidence SHA-256 digest and what happens when a SQL snapshot changes?
cases.reference_summary: Control HITL-DRIFT-SHA binds approvals to SHA256(normalized_question || sql_snapshot_sha256 || sorted_passage_sha256s || answer_sha256) and transitions drifted records to REJECTED.

cases.question: According to framework ARCH-BVA-01 and target ARCH-COST-20MS, when should we build a governed hybrid copilot and what is the token reduction target?
cases.reference_summary: Framework ARCH-BVA-01 mandates building a governed hybrid copilot when strict numerical parity, freshness gates, and HITL audit trails are required, targeting <25 ms CPU latency and 75.0% token reduction.
